response: An Alaska Airlines Flight 448 made an emergency landing on Monday after a worker from a contractor handling loading the luggage fell asleep and accidentally triggered an banging in the cargo hold. The worker was taken to a hospital as a precaution but passed a drug test and was later discharged. The flight was delayed for several hours and the passengers were spooked by the incident. Alaska Airlines is investigating the incident and has stated that all ramp employees have security badges and undergo full criminal background checks before being hired.
